cwe_content.cwe: CWE-539,Use of Persistent Cookies Containing Sensitive Information

candidate.Reason: This method determines when to set a cookie based on session modification or permanent session with refresh each request, but doesn't account for the 'Vary: Cookie' header in all cases where cookies are set, potentially leading to cache poisoning.
The 'Vary: Cookie' header is only added when the session is accessed, not when it's being refreshed (permanent session with SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST), which could lead to cache poisoning.

candidate.Code:
expires = self.get_expiration_time(app, session)
        val = self.get_signing_serializer(app).dumps(dict(session))  
        response.set_cookie(
            name,
            val,  
            expires=expires,
            httponly=httponly,
            domain=domain,
            path=path,
            secure=secure,
            samesite=samesite,
        )
candidate.Reason: This sets a persistent cookie (when session.permanent is True) without ensuring proper cache control headers are set, potentially exposing sensitive session information through proxy caching.
